name: Bendigo Community Telco
summary: Bendigo community phone company (2001; local/STD/ISD calls + internet); still trading as a regional NBN/voice/IT provider (BENDIGO TELCO LTD, ACN 089 782 203).

events.details: Not defunct: BENDIGO TELCO LTD remains active (ABN 88 089 782 203) and still supplies residential/business NBN internet, voice and managed IT; rebranded from Bendigo Community Telco to Bendigo Telco c.2014. Earlier records mistook a 2008 homepage redesign for closure.
